children: Pinnacle West Capital Corp. (PNW) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 04, 2026.

Pinnacle West Capital Corporation ("Pinnacle West") will be participating in various meetings with securities analysts and investors in September 2026 and will be utilizing handouts during those meetings. Copies of the handouts are attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/764622/000076462226000046/pnw-20260904.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/764622/000076462226000046/0000764622-26-000046-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
